title: Cinderborn: The Conclave Trials
description: Turn-based hex strategy: a lowcaste imposter fights through a rigged trial of noble houses

title: Green Circle TD
description: Maze tower defense: creeps circle in from four corners to the center, passing every position. TRUE ONLINE MULTIPLAYER (2–4 players): WC3-style lobby with 4-letter room codes, authoritative server, per-player build zones, shared lives. Plus procedural turret + creep graphics, Lv1-3 upgrades and 3-way specializations, auto-advancing waves (Space to stack early), armor-vs-damage matrix including WC3 chaos damage, air-targeting restriction, randomized wave order, distinct creep archetypes, local hot-seat co-op, aura towers, Mint economy tower, interest economy, stackable waves, 1×/2×/3× speed, and 30 escalating waves to a multi-phase boss.

title: Ironmarch
description: Warcraft-1-style real-time strategy. Command the Human Alliance against an Orc Horde AI: harvest gold and lumber, build a base (Town Hall, Farm, Barracks, Blacksmith, Guard Tower), train Peasants, Footmen, Archers and Knights, scout under fog of war, and destroy the enemy base before their raiders destroy yours.

title: Line Tower Wars
description: Standalone web Line Tower Wars, inspired by the Warcraft 3 custom map — build a maze, leak creeps to your opponent.

title: Pokémon Speedrun Gen 1
description: Voice-first (tap fallback) Gen 1 Pokémon speedrun. Name all 151 as fast as you can.

title: Shard Dominion
description: Late-90s Westwood-style RTS: a 20-mission four-act campaign with a branching Seal/Harness choice, 3 mechanically distinct factions, a prerequisite-gated tech tree with stacking research, buildable superweapons (Ion Cannon / Resonance Device), a living planet that hunts the greedy, saves/replays, and experimental 1v1/2v2 lockstep. v0.56 GAMEPLAY OVERHAUL: real RA-pace economy (tier 2 ~1 min, tier 3 ~2-3 min), 15-25 minute matches on a 48x48 map with contested expansions, three true AI difficulty personalities that build bases, expand, retreat and play behind fog-of-war, an RA-style win condition (no more hunting the last rifleman), and the full 24-unit / 23-structure roster reachable from a paged data-driven sidebar. v0.58: procedurally generated skirmish maps (Shard Meridian, The Narrows, Broken Veins) with a fairness-validated seeded generator, and mission boot now centers the camera on your HQ.

title: Shard Dominion v2
description: Classic sci-fi RTS on Aether Prime — bake-off build 3, from the Hermes Execution Manifest v2.0 (veterancy, hazard zones)

title: Shard Dominion: Chat Version
description: Classic sci-fi RTS on Aether Prime — bake-off build 2, from the chat-version build package

title: Shard Dominion: Fable
description: A real-time strategy game where you harvest Aether Shards and expand your dominion across a procedurally generated world.

title: Tank You Again
description: Real-time multiplayer tank arena. 8-way movement, fuel-as-health, landmines, masked radar, 10-tier rank ladder.

title: Tower Wars
description: Maze tower defense with income/sends, hero towers, and large-map pan/zoom control.

title: Tower Wars II
description: Branching tower upgrades, balanced enemy waves, and a fresh take on maze TD.
